content.title: Why Royal Caribbean (RCL) Stock Is Down Today
content.summary: Shares of cruise vacation company Royal Caribbean (NYSE:RCL) fell 5% in the morning session after its peer Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings reported third-quarter revenue that fell short of expectations, sparking a sector-wide sell-off. Norwegian posted revenue of $2.94 billion, which missed analysts' forecasts of $3.02 billion. content.title: Norwegian Cruise Stock Sinks After Earnings Beat. What’s Worrying Wall Street.
content.summary: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings  stock fell sharply Tuesday even after the cruise operator beat earnings estimates.  Adjusted earnings of $1.20 a share topped the $1.16 consensus among analysts polled by FactSet.  The cruise operator now expects net yield to 2.3% to 2.4%, or 2.4% to 2.5% in constant currency, down from 2.5% previously.
